title: The weak forward equation from a martingale balance
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: The weak forward equation from a martingale balance. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: Let P be a probability law on a measurable sample space and E a compact second-countable topological space with its Borel sigma algebra. Let X be a jointly measurable process on nonnegative time with values in E and continuous paths almost surely. Let g be a continuous real test, A a jointly continuous real field on time and state, and M a real martingale for a filtration on nonnegative time under P. Suppose that for each fixed t≥0, the increment g(X_t)−g(X_0) equals the time integral of A(v,X_v) plus M_t−M_0 almost surely. At every s≥0, the expectation of g(X_t) has derivative within the nonnegative half-line equal to the expectation of A(s,X_s).
